steps.action: Precondition: location selected (else Add to cart disabled)
Optionally choose variant, set Quantity with +/- (1..available), click 'Add to cart'
POST /api/cart/items 201; message 'Product added to cart.' + 'View cart' link; header 'Cart (n)' increments
Alternatively click card 'Add to cart' (qty 1) -> button shows 'Added to cart'

evidence.observation: Cart (0) -> Cart (2) after adding DeWalt qty 2; Cart (3) after adding Stanley from /category/hand-tools card
